WHERE
sales_orders.status = 2
sales_orders.status = -5
sales_orders.status = -5
sales_orders.status = 2
AND sales_orders.id NOT IN ( SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details INNER JOIN logistics ON logistics.id = logistic_details.logistic_id WHERE logistics.status > 0 )
AND sales_orders.company_id = #{filter.companyId}
AND sales_orders.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE cgroup_id = #{filter.organizationGroupId})
AND sales_orders.customer_id = #{filter.organizationId}

WHERE
logistics.status = 1
logistics.status = 2
logistics.status = 3
logistics.status > 0
AND logistics.company_id = #{filter.companyId}
AND logistics.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE cgroup_id = #{filter.organizationGroupId})
AND logistics.customer_id = #{filter.organizationId}
mapper.select:
SELECT 1 AS type, sales_orders.id AS id, (SELECT `date` FROM deliveries WHERE id = sales_orders.delivery_id) AS deliveryDate, NULL AS logisticDeliveryDate, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, (SELECT code FROM deliveries WHERE id = sales_orders.delivery_id) AS dnCode, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, NULL AS logisticReceiveNumber, sales_orders.status AS statusInvoice, (SELECT status FROM logistics WHERE id IN (SELECT logistic_id FROM logistic_details WHERE sales_order_id = sales_orders.id)) AS statusLogistic, NULL AS createdBy, NULL AS modifiedBy FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS type, logistics.id AS id, NULL AS deliveryDate, logistics.date AS logisticDeliveryDate, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id)) AS invoiceCode, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM deliveries WHERE id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id))) AS dnCode, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM logistic_receive_results INNER JOIN logistic_receives ON logistic_receive_results.id = logistic_receives.logistic_receive_result_id WHERE logistic_receives.logistic_id = logistics.id) AS logisticReceiveNumber, (SELECT status FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id)) AS statusInvoice, logistics.status AS statusLogistic, (SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE id = (SELECT created_by FROM logistic_receives WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id ORDER BY created ASC LIMIT 1)) AS createdBy, (SELECT IF((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM logistic_receives WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id) > 1, (SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE id = (SELECT created_by FROM logistic_receives WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1)), '')) AS modifiedBy FROM logistics LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = logistics.customer_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(deliveryDate, logisticDeliveryDate) ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT sales_orders.id AS id FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id
UNION ALL
SELECT logistics.id AS id FROM logistics LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = logistics.customer_id
) AS result

SELECT logistics.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id)) AS invoiceCode, customers.id AS organizationId, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id IN (SELECT location_group_id FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id))) AS warehouseName, logistic_receive_results.note AS note, logistic_receive_results.code AS code, logistic_receive_results.date AS date FROM logistic_receive_results INNER JOIN logistic_receives ON logistic_receive_results.id = logistic_receives.logistic_receive_result_id INNER JOIN logistics ON logistics.id = logistic_receives.logistic_id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = logistics.customer_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = logistic_receive_results.created_by WHERE logistics.id = #{id} GROUP BY logistics.id
SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = #{logisticId}

SELECT id FROM sales_order_details WHERE sales_order_id IN
#{id}

choose.when: SELECT 1 AS type, sales_orders.id AS id, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, customers.id AS organizationId, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id = sales_orders.location_group_id) AS warehouseName FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id WHERE sales_orders.id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 2 AS type, logistics.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id)) AS invoiceCode, customers.id AS organizationId, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id IN (SELECT location_group_id FROM sales_orders WHERE id IN (SELECT sales_order_id FROM logistic_details WHERE logistic_id = logistics.id))) AS warehouseName FROM logistics LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = logistics.customer_id WHERE logistics.id = #{id}

mapper.select:
SELECT 1 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sod.product_id AS itemId, p.name AS itemName, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.small_val_uom AS smallValUom, SUM(lr.qty) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, sod.conversion AS conversion, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, 'Delivered' AS status, lr.received_date AS deliveryDate, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, lr.created AS created FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_details sod ON sod.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = sod.product_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = sod.qty_uom_id INNER JOIN logistic_receives lr ON lr.product_id = sod.product_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = lr.created_by AND lr.qty_uom_id = sod.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) WHERE so.id IN #{id} GROUP BY sod.product_id, sod.qty_uom_id HAVING SUM(lr.qty) >= SUM(sod.qty + sod.qty_free)
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sos.service_id AS itemId, s.name AS itemName, s.sku AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, SUM(lr.qty) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'Delivered' AS status, lr.received_date AS deliveryDate, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, lr.created AS created FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_services sos ON sos.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN services s ON s.id = sos.service_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = s.uom_id INNER JOIN logistic_receives lr ON lr.product_id = sos.service_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = lr.created_by AND lr.qty_uom_id = s.uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) WHERE so.id IN #{id} GROUP BY sos.service_id, s.uom_id HAVING SUM(lr.qty) >= SUM(sos.qty + sos.qty_free)
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS type, u.id AS uomId, som.id AS itemId, som.description AS itemName, '' AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, SUM(lr.qty) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'Delivered' AS status, lr.received_date AS deliveryDate, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, lr.created AS created FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_miscs som ON som.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = som.qty_uom_id INNER JOIN logistic_receives lr ON lr.product_id = som.id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = lr.created_by AND lr.qty_uom_id = som.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) WHERE so.id IN #{id} GROUP BY som.id, som.qty_uom_id HAVING SUM(lr.qty) >= SUM(som.qty + som.qty_free)

SELECT 1 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sod.product_id AS itemId, p.name AS itemName, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.small_val_uom AS smallValUom, (SUM(sod.qty + sod.qty_free) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.total_delivered), 0)) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, sod.conversion AS conversion, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_details sod ON sod.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = sod.product_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = sod.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id, SUM(qty) as total_delivered FROM logistic_receives WHERE status IN (1,2) GROUP BY product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id ) lr ON lr.product_id = sod.product_id AND lr.qty_uom_id = sod.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr2 WHERE lr2.product_id = sod.product_id AND lr2.qty_uom_id = sod.qty_uom_id AND lr2.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr2.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY sod.product_id, sod.qty_uom_id HAVING qty > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sos.service_id AS itemId, s.name AS itemName, s.sku AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, (SUM(sos.qty + sos.qty_free) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.total_delivered), 0)) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_services sos ON sos.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN services s ON s.id = sos.service_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = s.uom_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id, SUM(qty) as total_delivered FROM logistic_receives WHERE status IN (1,2) GROUP BY product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id ) lr ON lr.product_id = sos.service_id AND lr.qty_uom_id = s.uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr2 WHERE lr2.product_id = sos.service_id AND lr2.qty_uom_id = s.uom_id AND lr2.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr2.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY sos.service_id, s.uom_id HAVING qty > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS type, u.id AS uomId, som.id AS itemId, som.description AS itemName, '' AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, (SUM(som.qty + som.qty_free) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.total_delivered), 0)) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_miscs som ON som.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = som.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id, SUM(qty) as total_delivered FROM logistic_receives WHERE status IN (1,2) GROUP BY product_id, qty_uom_id, sales_order_id ) lr ON lr.product_id = som.id AND lr.qty_uom_id = som.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr2 WHERE lr2.product_id = som.id AND lr2.qty_uom_id = som.qty_uom_id AND lr2.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr2.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY som.id, som.qty_uom_id HAVING qty > 0

SELECT 1 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sod.product_id AS itemId, p.name AS itemName, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.small_val_uom AS smallValUom, SUM(sod.qty + sod.qty_free) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, sod.conversion AS conversion, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_details sod ON sod.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = sod.product_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = sod.qty_uom_id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr WHERE lr.product_id = sod.product_id AND lr.qty_uom_id = sod.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY sod.product_id, sod.qty_uom_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS type, u.id AS uomId, sos.service_id AS itemId, s.name AS itemName, s.sku AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, SUM(sos.qty + sos.qty_free) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_services sos ON sos.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN services s ON s.id = sos.service_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = s.uom_id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr WHERE lr.product_id = sos.service_id AND lr.qty_uom_id = s.uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY sos.service_id, s.uom_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS type, u.id AS uomId, som.id AS itemId, som.description AS itemName, '' AS sku, '' AS upc, 1 AS smallValUom, SUM(som.qty + som.qty_free) AS qty, u.name AS uomName, so.customer_id AS organizationId, 1 AS conversion, '' AS isExpiredDate, 'To be shipped' AS status FROM sales_orders so INNER JOIN sales_order_miscs som ON som.sales_order_id = so.id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = som.qty_uom_id WHERE so.id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM logistic_receives lr WHERE lr.product_id = som.id AND lr.qty_uom_id = som.qty_uom_id AND lr.sales_order_id = so.id AND lr.status IN (1,2) ) GROUP BY som.id, som.qty_uom_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logistic_receive_results (date, customer_contact_id, note, sales_order_id, created, created_by) VALUES (#{logisticReceiveResult.date}, #{logisticReceiveResult.organizationContactId}, #{logisticReceiveResult.note}, #{logisticReceiveResult.saleInvoiceId}, NOW(), #{logisticReceiveResult.createdBy})
